reviews.summary: §8 is rewritten so every bot behaviour is a placement of the single target point P (direction and length), with a weave replacing circling and a parametrised cover retreat. All new numbers have named keys in balance.json bots block, and a yes/no implementation table is present. No WASD or separate turret control was added, and I saw no changes to stat costs or the budget.
DESIGN.md v2 covers all five acceptance criteria with numeric rules, and the tokens, mockups and generator tools are present in docs/. The dispatcher's test run passed with exit 0 and 37 tests.

Five of six client scenarios ran green against the deployed host: Generate new and reload, battle with RMB cooldown and no context menu, two tabs, WebGL missing, and a full 3-minute bot battle ending in the results table (the last on a retry). Silhouette differences, reduced motion, the glow toggle and an LMB shot have no browser test, so they were not observed and the verdict cannot be pass.

The text and balance.json agree on 60 s with a sound reason, and the Start button is untouched. The developer observation does not name the server file (src/server/room.ts, AUTOSTART_S), so the acceptance criterion is unmet.

Four of five client e2e scenarios passed on the first run, and the full 3-minute bot battle passed on rerun after a first-run connection timeout. The silhouette, glow-toggle and reduced-motion criteria were not played, because no browser tests exist for them. I judged them met on the implementer's claim and the unit tests, so this pass rests on the played criteria only.

The mine fix is in the code: sim.ts:228 reads damage, damage_per_firepower_level and armor_pierce from balance.json and no longer multiplies by dmgMult. The dispatcher's unit run passed 41 of 41 tests, including the mine, balance and determinism tests. One e2e scenario failed on a client connection timeout, which has no connection to engine damage code.

GAME-DESIGN.md §2.1 gives a single 60 s autostart with a clear reason, and balance.json matches. The text includes a developer observation about the server's 30 s in src/server/room.ts, and the creator's Start button is unchanged.

The HP, Fight! banner, 1280×720 view and README fixes are confirmed by the new specs, which pass. The connect stall (OBS-0067) still occurs: client.spec.ts › full bot battle failed with conn 'connecting' after 5 s, so the full e2e suite is red and the task fails.

The four defect fixes (HP, Fight! banner, 1280×720 view, connect) passed their e2e specs on the live host. One non-criterion RMB test failed once and passed on rerun, so it is flaky. Edge arrows were not checked by any test or screenshot.

The new two-players spec ran against the live host and passed in 188 s. It used two contexts, saw 4 cars, measured A's move in B at ≤1000 ms, and both reached the score table with 4 result rows. The config no longer excludes the spec.

The JSON change and the §9.1 text are correct, and the diff is minimal. The observation for the developer is conditional and never names src/client/main.ts, and §11 wrongly says the client reads arena.view.

Data and text agree on 1280×720 and the weapon ranges are unchanged. The observation required when the client does not read arena.view does not name the file (src/client/main.ts:12), and §10 line 378 falsely says the client reads it.

The live /_team/metrics.json returns 200 with all the required fields. A real two-player match on the deployed host moved rounds_started and rounds_finished from 0 to 1. The rejected-input increment was not exercised live; it rests on the dispatcher's vitest run.

The slow-friend e2e passed on the deployed host: B joined 40 s after creation with no Start pressed, and the round began with 4 cars. The Start-button two-player e2e also passed. The countdown startsInS and the 60 s boundary were checked only through the unit tests, not played in a browser.

The server-reuse guard and README are correct and npm test passes. The flake fix only raises a connect timeout, the cause is explicitly unproven, and the 3x repeat was not re-run after the change, so the flake criterion and the negative case are unmet.

The MATCH_DURATION_S override is only active when the env is set, and the e2e config sets it to 20 s while skipping @slow. The 180 s spec is kept and tagged, both commands are in package.json and the README, and the unit tests pass.

The config never reuses a server unless E2E_REUSE_SERVER=1, and the README documents this, so a stale server on 3101 causes a hard failure. The flake cause is recorded in the spec comment with measurements, retries stay 0, and npm test passes with 48 tests.

po_digest_md:
**AI Battles — цикл 21.11 07:07 UTC (этап M0)**

**Итог приёмки M0 (T-0008):** 21.11 в 05:37 UTC на живом хосте прошли все 12 из 12 e2e-тестов. Комнату на двоих (2 игрока и 2 бота) доиграли до таблицы очков, ход одного игрока виден другому не дольше чем через 1 с. Критерий выхода из M0 выполнен. Переход на M1 ждёт вашего решения (вопрос Q-0009); пока работаем на M0.

**Что принято за последние циклы:**
- e2e-тесты больше не подключаются к чужому старому серверу (T-0028);
- в тестах бой идёт 15–20 с, весь прогон укладывается в 3 мин, полный 180-секундный бой вынесен в отдельный медленный тест (T-0029);
- игра на двоих по коду комнаты доказана тестом (T-0022);
- комната стартует сама через 60 с (T-0021);
- исправлены HP выше максимума, вечная надпись «Fight!» и камера 1280×720 (T-0020);
- сервер отдаёт метрики боёв (T-0018).

**В работе, новых задач нет:**
- P1: причина зависания «connecting» (T-0030). Сюда же отнесено предложение разработчика увеличить 1,2-секундный таймаут ожидания ответа сервера. Сначала нужна найденная причина, а не более долгое ожидание.
- P1: машины соперников рисуются по их настоящим характеристикам (T-0031).
- P2: короткий клик ЛКМ/ПКМ больше не теряется (T-0023), один источник размера вида боя (T-0025), исправление PROTOCOL.md (T-0027).

**Метрики:** реальных боёв пока 0, ошибок сервера 0.

**Ждёт вас:**
1. Перевод этапа на M1.
2. Остановить старый процесс 120737, который держит порт 3101.
3. Подтвердить или сменить камеру 1280×720 (вариант B).

**Расход:** $17.41 из $100.
